description: Search the internal safe Template Icon Catalog (curated Iconify collections) by keyword, collection, or visual style. Use when designing templates or adding icon decorations. Select ≤8 candidates and confirm choice before materializing. Alternatives: Call get_icon once an iconId is selected to generate the immutable asset. Read-only catalog search; does not consume quota.

collection.description: Optional icon collection filter (e.g. lucide, tabler).

limit.description: Max number of candidates to return (default 8; prefer small limits for token budget).

query.description: Search term for icon meaning or keyword (e.g. arrow, checkmark, star).

style.description: Icon rendering style: outline | solid | any

name: search_icons

icons.description: Candidate icons array with id, name, and previewSvg.

title: Search icons
